query: If airlines eliminated the most common cabin-service complaints in the reviews, how much would the average Overall Rating improve?

per_column.name: cabin_service_complaint_type
per_column.rationale: Directly answers the query by categorising the most common cabin-service complaints, enabling counterfactual grouping on Overall Rating. Sample values (seat_comfort, no_complaint) are well grounded in the review text.

per_column.name: crew_proactivity
per_column.rationale: Gives a genuine new axis (service quality dimension) that supports the complaint analysis. Values match text: welcoming/regular-round crew tagged proactive, complaint-heavy review reactive. Some subjectivity but defensible.

per_column.name: cabin_class_service_gap
per_column.rationale: Combines class and service shortfall into a useful comparative axis relevant to cabin-service complaints. Sample mappings are reasonable, though economy_below_expectation for a seat-comfort complaint infers class from context; generally warranted.

per_column.name: service_consistency_issue
per_column.rationale: Adds a consistency axis that can correlate with rating impact. Partly overlaps conceptually with complaint type but offers distinct grouping. Values align with text (consistently_good, consistently_poor).

per_column.name: post_covid_service_decline_flag
per_column.rationale: Weakly tied to the cabin-complaint query and highly skewed (825 false). Groundedness is uncertain: without explicit dates/covid mentions in most reviews, a true/false decline flag risks unsupported inference, though 'false' as default for silent rows is defensible.

per_column.name: route_type
per_column.rationale: Haul length is derivable from Route and offers a plausible segmentation axis, though only indirectly related to eliminating cabin-service complaints. Samples (Jakarta-Singapore short_haul, Singapore-London ultra_long_haul) are accurate.

judge.rationale: The core column (cabin_service_complaint_type) directly enables the counterfactual analysis the query demands, and several supporting columns add genuine service-quality axes. Most values are sound readings of the review text. The main weakness is post_covid_service_decline_flag, which is only tangentially relevant and relies on inference the source text often does not support. Groundedness is otherwise strong, with silent rows handled via NULL/false defaults.
